name: ahm-ood-audit-measurements
description: Measurements released with the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track paper "Auditing Attention Head Masking for Out-of-Distribution Detection: Cross-Architecture Failures and Polarity Inversions": per-seed AUROC and FPR95 values of post-hoc OOD detectors on LayoutLMv3-base, ViT-B/16, RoBERTa-base and RoBERTa-large, the attention-head masks, and the near-OOD split configurations. The release contains only these derived artifacts; no data from the source datasets is redistributed.
rai:dataLimitations: Results cover LayoutLMv3-base, ViT-B/16, RoBERTa-base and RoBERTa-large, five fine-tuning seeds per configuration (fifteen for the two headline comparisons). They describe these models, datasets and protocols and should not be read as properties of other architectures, scales or data. Implementation details that affect specific scores are stated in the paper. Tobacco3482 split members are rows of the processed dataset (see split_configs/README.md).
rai:dataBiases: The measurements inherit the composition of the source datasets: English-language text (SST-2, MultiNLI, AG News, 20 Newsgroups), scanned business documents from specific sources and periods (Tobacco3482, FinanceDocs) and natural-image benchmarks (CIFAR, SVHN, DTD).
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. The release contains numbers (AUROC, FPR95), binary head masks and integer split indices only; no documents, images or text are included.
rai:dataUseCases: Reproducing and re-analysing the paper's results (for example with other statistics or effect sizes) and comparing post-hoc OOD detectors across architectures. Not intended as training data.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Supports more reliable evaluation of OOD detectors before deployment by making cross-architecture results checkable; no direct social risk was identified.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Maintained by the author in the GitHub repository (issues for questions and corrections); the fine-tuned checkpoints are archived on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23338711).
prov:wasGeneratedBy: Each backbone was fine-tuned per seed on the in-distribution data and scored with post-hoc OOD detectors by the scripts in this repository (see REPRODUCTION.md); the table is written by statistics/export_per_seed_auroc.py and the statistics by statistics/compute_paper_statistics.py.
